issue_request: FHIR-20842 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core StructureMap and requested that dependent rule variable references no longer be modeled as string-only StructureMap.group.rule.dependent.variable; the final resolution renamed the element to StructureMap.group.rule.dependent.parameter and reused the StructureMap.group.rule.target.parameter backbone.

No FHIR-20842 application was found for the active FHIR ModelInfo library, which still exposed StructureMap.Dependent.variable as List<FHIR.string>.
additional_context: StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini, and the Library examples publish Library/FHIR-ModelInfo as version 6.0.0 current-build content. The fhir.ini redirect from StructureMap.group.rule.dependent.variable to dependent.parameter preserves old anchors. Related FHIR-20844 concerns the target.parameter backbone choices and is already represented on the combined branch by 014f84d9853469f06a846d9e027ad8bce4d2ebfd, so it was not duplicated.
